items.title: Konata Mumpfield: Team-high receiving yardage total
items.text:
Mumpfield brought in three of four targets for 81 yards in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.title: Carson Beck: Throws two picks in NFL debut
items.text:
Beck was 11-for-18 passing for 108 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions and had one rush for one yard during Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.

items.title: Matthew Stafford: Three TD passes despite receiver injuries
items.text:
Stafford completed 18 of 26 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed twice for minus-2 yards in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.title: Tetairoa McMillan: Held to three catches in win over Saints

items.title: Chuba Hubbard: Career-best scrimmage yards total in win
items.text:
Hubbard carried the ball 27 times for 92 yards and two touchdowns and caught all five of his targets for 80 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.

items.title: Kyren Williams: Comfortably outpaced by Corum and Rivers
